w: At 10.45 am, Swamishri performed the arti of murtis at the new Satsang Hall and sanctified the mudhouse of a devotee.
Bangalore : 1 - 2 - 3 - Secunderabad : 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - 5
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and Guru Parampara for a hari mandir in Ambach –dejha Faliya Village.

The special joy today was that Pramukh Swami Maharaj's meetings with devotees were starting again from today, as before. The meetings were arranged on the tenth floor of Pramukh Sadan. Swamishri was going in the lift. The sadhus told him the meetings were on the tenth floor.
Swamishri said, "Why have you kept it so high up?"
The sadhus said, "All arrangements have been made. The devotees will come up by lift and go back down by lift; no one will have any trouble."
Swamishri said, "But how much expense there will be! If the lift is used, electricity is used too. Can't it be kept downstairs?" Swamishri expressed his wish.

During the meetings, Atulbhai and Bharatbhai Davda came for darshan. Both brothers have rendered special service in the organisation's construction work. In particular, they keep the machines used when some old structure has to be demolished.
Speaking of this, Abhayswarup Swami said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "They are useful to the organisation. They do demolition everywhere."
Swamishri said, laughing, "Don't use the word demolition; say repairing."

During the meetings, a youth came for darshan. This youth, who was a little eccentric mentally, had written a letter to Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He gave the letter to Swamishri and said, "I have written in this the points on how to have a long life; please read it." Swamishri had the letter taken, and after his meal he did lovingly read the whole letter, accepting his devotion.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was having his meal. Meanwhile Balram Bhagat told of the incident when Shriji Maharaj, sitting in Halvad, ate three maunds of sugar, and said, "You too are the form of Maharaj, so you too should eat a little more."
Swamishri immediately said, "He was God. So he could make much out of little and little out of much. What he does, we cannot do."
Krishnavallabh Swami said, "Let everything else remain, but at least finish the khichdi."
Balvir Bhagat said, "Maharaj never had to be told like this."
Balram Bhagat said, "Maharaj used to fulfil the wishes of the devotees."
Swamishri said, "He was God, wasn't he! God can do anything."
Balram Bhagat said, "That same Shriji Maharaj resides in you, so you too do the same!"
Swamishri said, "Everything happens according to his wish."
Having said this, while swallowing a pill, Swamishri said, "How can the khichdi go down? My stomach gets filled just by taking these pills."

Rajeshbhai (Ranip) phoned. A baby had been born to his son Nirav. He asked for a name. Pramukh Swami Maharaj named him "Parth", and Rajeshbhai said, "I am putting the phone to the baby's ear. Please bless him."

Giving inspiration and initiation, Swamishri said to this newborn baby, "Parth! Jai Swaminarayan. Your name is Parth, so become strong and powerful like Parth, that is, Arjun. May Maharaj give you strength and may you have happiness and peace. Study well, have devotion and be happy; these are my blessings."
Today, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was leaving the assembly and entering his residence, a boy named Akshar recited a couplet in American accented Gujarati:
"Guru and Govind (God) both stand before me; at whose feet shall I bow first?
Glory to the guru, who showed me Govind."
Saying this, he asked Swamishri, "Who is such a guru?"
"Pramukh Swami Maharaj," Swamishri answered without a moment's delay. He does not miss a single chance to sing the glory of his guru.
